description: A daycare center has children they must pick up and can use two types of vehicles: bus or a personal car. A bus can carry 9 children while a personal car can carry 4 children. The daycare has to pick up at least 100 children. Additionally, due to limitations of pollution, there must be more buses than personal cars. But some children require extra attention. Therefore, there must be at least 5 personal cars. How many of each form of transportation should the daycare center schedule for to minimize the total number of vehicles?

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of vehicles (buses and personal cars) used to pick up the children"

constraints.description: The total number of children transported by buses and cars must be at least MinChildren
The number of buses must be greater than the number of personal cars
The number of personal cars must be at least MinCars
The number of buses and personal cars must be non-negative integers

NumBuses.definition: The number of buses scheduled by the daycare center

NumCars.definition: The number of personal cars scheduled by the daycare center
